# GL Insurance Brokers

> Commercial insurance brokerage in Fort Myers, Florida, specializing in General Liability, Workers' Compensation, Commercial Auto, and Excess Liability coverage for contractors, tradespeople, and small businesses throughout Florida. Veteran-owned and operated by Alexander Farr. Serves clients statewide as a service-area business.

## Key facts

- **Business name:** GL Insurance Brokers
- **Owner:** Alexander Farr, U.S. Army veteran (Missile Technician, 4 years), graduate of Florida Gulf Coast University (Business Management)
- **Phone:** (239) 898-2323
- **Hours:** Open daily, 8:00am–7:00pm ET
- **Service area:** State of Florida, concentrated in the Southwest Florida corridor (Lee, Collier, and Charlotte counties)
- **Business type:** Service-area commercial insurance brokerage; no walk-in retail location
- **Experience:** Eight years in commercial insurance
- **Model:** Independent broker comparing quotes across multiple carriers; clients work directly with the owner rather than a call center

## Coverage types

- [General Liability Insurance](https://www.glinsurancebrokers.com/insurance/general-liability): Third-party bodily injury and property damage coverage for Florida contractors and businesses, including certificate-of-insurance requirements.
- [Workers' Compensation Insurance](https://www.glinsurancebrokers.com/insurance/workers-compensation): Statutory Florida workers' comp for contractors and employers, including class-code placement.
- [Commercial Auto Insurance](https://www.glinsurancebrokers.com/insurance/commercial-auto): Vehicle coverage for work trucks, vans, and commercial fleets.
- [Excess / Umbrella Liability](https://www.glinsurancebrokers.com/insurance/excess-liability): Additional limits above underlying general liability and auto policies, commonly required by contracts.
- [All coverage types](https://www.glinsurancebrokers.com/insurance/)
